The original capacity generator, manifest, and generated FIT bytes are dedicated
to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Original author: ticket-inventory synthetic Runs smoke corpus. Original generator
and manifest explicitly designate CC0 and entirely synthetic provenance. Copied
and adapted only to document correct cadence units and allow an output directory;
encoded FIT bytes and their golden SHA-256 hashes are preserved.

No recorded activity, personal/private FIT, production identifiers, SDK, secret,
or network source is required. Coordinates and serial numbers are invented
privacy canaries, not real people, devices, or places observed by the generator.
Python standard library only; public FIT field IDs and CRC arithmetic were
inspected against the MIT-licensed fitparser 0.11.0 profile, not SDK code.

Record message20 field4 is native cycles/min. The declared synthetic envelope
170..190 cycles/min becomes340..380 canonical running steps/min. The unchanged
formula170+(recordIndex*7)%21 actually emits170,177,184 cycles/min, which become
340,354,368 steps/min. These intentionally synthetic values are not physiological
validation claims.

Reproduce without adding large binary files to the repository:
python3 apps/api/tests/fixtures/runs/capacity/generate.py --output /tmp/garmin-runs-capacity-fixtures

Generated files: chart_1h_3600.fit (3600 records), full_export_100k.fit (100000
records), no_hr_power_600.fit (600 records), and manifest.json. The committed
manifest records exact byte sizes, golden hashes, session boundaries, synthetic
privacy canaries, units, fixed parameters, and CC0 provenance. Output FIT files
are intentionally not committed. The generator accepts --output; without it,
the output directory defaults to the directory containing generate.py.

Provided without warranty. No medical or physiological precision is implied.
